question: Should maintainers wait for this uneditable conflicting fork PR to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The underlying bug remains valid and this PR is a useful candidate, but automation cannot repair the fork in place or provide the missing real delivery proof for the contributor.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, ports the delivery policy to SourceDeliveryPlan, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the author to rebase, enable maintainer edits or push an update, resolve the findings, and add redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause stale branch
options.body: Close or pause this PR while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43866 open for a fresh implementation path.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, ports the delivery policy to SourceDeliveryPlan, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame places the relevant hook and SourceDeliveryPlan surfaces closest to this owner trail.
